goal: Increase weekday sales by 15% within three months.
constraints: No delivery driver. No additional staff. Experiments must run within existing opening hours.
brief:
Rheinblick Café is a fictional independent café in Düsseldorf with 28 seats.
Open Monday–Friday, 07:30–17:00.
Baseline weekday revenue is €600 per day, measured over the last four weeks.
Average order value is €8; average variable ingredient and packaging cost is €3 per order.
Two employees work each weekday; no additional staff can be hired this quarter.
Kitchen has spare capacity from 09:00 to 11:00, up to 15 extra lunch boxes daily.
The café has no delivery driver or delivery vehicle.
Office buildings are within a ten-minute walk; their employee counts are unknown.
There is no loyalty programme and no reliable repeat-customer baseline.
The café has an Instagram account with 450 followers; no paid-campaign performance data exists.
feedback:

I think the café already delivers, but I have never ordered delivery.
competitors:
Bohnenwerk (fictional): lunch bundle €9.50; collection only; paper stamp card. Customer volumes unknown.
LunchDock (fictional): office lunch boxes €12; delivery requires a €60 minimum order. Profitability unknown.
Stadtpause (fictional): coffee €3.80; advertises on Instagram; no published conversion or campaign spend data.
